faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CMO Ballia Urban ASHA posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Urban ASHA posts is 01 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Urban ASHA post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Urban ASHA post is High School passed from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Urban ASHA recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Urban ASHA posts is between 20 years to 45 years. Age relaxation details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Urban ASHA post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies announced for the Urban ASHA posts in Chief Medical Office Ballia.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CMO Ballia Urban ASHA recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Urban ASHA posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Urban ASHA posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Urban ASHA posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Urban ASHA posts includes marks-based selection, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Urban ASHA position?
faq.answer: The Urban ASHA positions are contractual in nature, as per the official notification released by CMO Ballia.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Chief Medical Office Ballia, which is https://ballia.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is मु०चि०अ०/शहरी आशा चयन/2026-27/५७४०.
